vantage.configuration.title: Vantage Settings
vantage.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Draw LOD terrain beyond the vanilla render distance.
vantage.configuration.renderDistance.too: How far distant terrain is drawn on the ground. Higher up it reaches further by itself. Tip: lower the vanilla render distance to 8-12 and raise this instead.
vantage.configuration.pixelsPerVoxel.too: Largest on-screen size of one LOD voxel. Lower is sharper but slower.
Singleplayer: fill land nobody has explored from the world generator (terrain, biomes, trees), so the ground never ends. Explored chunks replace it; your save is never changed.
vantage.configuration.altitudeViewFactor: High up, terrain reaches at least this many times your height above sea level. 0 turns it off.
vantage.configuration.hazeDistance.toolt: Distance over which air at sea level hides about two thirds of the view. Air thins with height, so from high up the ground stays clear.
vantage.configuration.atmosphereHeight.t: Air gets about 2.7x thinner every this many blocks above sea level.
vantage.configuration.planetRadius.toolt: Bend distant terrain like a planet of this radius, with a real horizon. 0 keeps the world flat. Try 100000, or 20000 for a small planet.
vantage.configuration.caveCulling.toolti: Drop unlit caves and buried blocks, which can never be seen from far away. Much cheaper to store and draw.
vantage.configuration.importExistingChun: Singleplayer: build LODs in the background from every chunk the save already contains.
vantage.configuration.workerThreads.tool: Background threads for building LODs. 0 picks automatically.
vantage.configuration.uploadBudgetKiB.to: Most geometry sent to the GPU per frame. Lower values avoid stutter on slow GPUs.
vantage.configuration.gpuMemoryMiB.toolt: Most video memory used for LOD geometry.
vantage.configuration.ramCacheMiB.toolti: Most memory used for decoded LOD sections.
vantage.configuration.fogStart.tooltip: Where terrain starts fading out towards the end of the LOD distance, as a fraction of it.
